FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable : BOOL;
    rawValue : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    filteredValue : REAL;
    windowFull : BOOL;
    sampleCount : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    tmp_buffer : ARRAY[0..7] OF REAL;
    tmp_count : INT;
    tmp_write_index : INT;
    tmp_sum : REAL;
    tmp_i : INT;
END_VAR

(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
filteredValue: enabled scan recomputed mean of tmp_count samples; on disable retained last mean.
sampleCount: enabled increments to 8 then holds at 8; disable same-scan reset 0.
windowFull: equals tmp_count=8 while enabled; disable same-scan reset FALSE.
FIFO: tmp_buffer insert positions 0..7, full replace oldest at tmp_write_index, then advance 0..7.
Unspecified: rawValue on disable ignored; non-full filters use current count only.
*)

IF enable THEN
    IF tmp_count < 8 THEN
        tmp_buffer[tmp_count] := rawValue;
        tmp_count := tmp_count + 1;
        IF tmp_count < 8 THEN
            tmp_write_index := tmp_count;
        ELSE
            tmp_write_index := 0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        tmp_buffer[tmp_write_index] := rawValue;
        tmp_write_index := tmp_write_index + 1;
        IF tmp_write_index > 7 THEN
            tmp_write_index := 0;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
    tmp_sum := 0.0;
    FOR tmp_i := 0 TO tmp_count - 1 DO
        tmp_sum := tmp_sum + tmp_buffer[tmp_i];
    END_FOR;
    IF tmp_count > 0 THEN
        filteredValue := tmp_sum / INT_TO_REAL(tmp_count);
    END_IF;
    sampleCount := tmp_count;
    windowFull := (tmp_count = 8);
ELSE
    tmp_count := 0;
    tmp_write_index := 0;
    sampleCount := 0;
    windowFull := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
